1 
                                        PRIVACY POLICY (SOLITARIO)  
This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and 
shared when you visit or make a purchase from https://www.thesolitario.com/  (the 
“Site”). 
By providing your information, visiting our stores, or using our services, you 
acknowledge and consent to the practices described in this Policy.  
 
1. PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT  
1.1 Automatically Collected Informati on (Device Data)  
When you access the Website, we automatically collect certain technical information, 
including your browser type, IP address, time zone, cookies, device identifiers, pages 
viewed, referring URLs, and interaction patterns. This information helps us understand 
how users engage with the Website.  
We collect such information through cookies  (http://www.allaboutcookies.org ), log 
files, web beacons, tags, and pixels.  
1.2 Information You Provide (Order, Contact & Voluntary Data)  
When you place an order, register an account, visit our physical stores, or 
communicate with us, we may collect personal data such as your name, billing and 
shipping address, email address, phone number, transaction detail s, and 
communication records. Payment information is processed through secure third -party 
payment gateways, and we do not store card or banking details.  
We may also collect the following, where legally permitted:  
 Visit & Surveillance Data : Store visit logs , CCTV footage, and footfall data 
collected for safety, security, fraud prevention, and operational purposes;  
 Voluntarily Provided Information : Feedback, survey responses, reviews, 
complaints, or any information shared during interactions with our customer  
support team.  
 
2. HOW DO WE USE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION?  
By using the Site or Solitario App and/or purchasing from us, you agree to allow your 
personal information to be used as stated below.  
2 
 We use the Order Information that we collect generally to ful fil any orders placed 
through the Site (including processing your payment information, arranging for 
shipping, and providing you with invoices and/or order confirmations). Additionally, we 
use this Order Information to:   
- Communicate with you on SMS, Emai l, WhatsApp, RCS, etc.;   
- Screen our orders for potential risk or fraud; and   
- Provide you with information or advertising relating to our products or services.  
We use the Device Information that we collect to help us screen for potential risk and 
fraud (in particular, your IP address), and more generally to improve and optimize our 
Site (for example, by generating analytics about how our customers browse and 
interact with the Site, and to assess the success of our marketing and advertising 
campaigns).  
 
3. SHARING YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION   
We share your Personal Information with third parties to help us use your Personal 
Information, as described above. For example, we use Shopify to power our online 
store --you can read more about how Shopify uses your Pe rsonal Information here: 
https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy  . We use Delhivery to deliver products to your 
doorstep. We also use Google Analytics to help us understand how our customers use 
the Site -- you can read more about how Google uses your Personal Information here: 
https://www.google.com/intl/en/policies/privacy/  . You can also opt -out of Google 
Analytics here: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.  
Finally, we may also share your Personal Information to comply with applicable laws 
and regulations, to respond to a subpoena, search warrant or other lawful request for 
information we receive, or to otherwise prot ect our rights.  
 
4. BEHAVIOURAL ADVERTISING   
As described above, we use your Personal Information to provide you with targeted 
advertisements or marketing communications we believe may be of interest to you. 
For more information about how targeted advertising works, you can visit the Network 
Advertising Initiative ’s (“NAI”) educational page at : 
http://www.networkadvertising.org/understanding -online -advertising/how -does -it-
work  . 
3 
 You can opt out of targeted advertising by using the links below:   
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/settings/?tab=ads   
- Google: https://www.google.com/settings/ads/anonymous  
 - Bing:  
 https://advertise.bingads.microsoft.com/en -us/resources/policies/personaliz ed-ads 
 
Additionally, you can opt out of some of these services by visiting the Digital 
Advertising Alliance ’s opt -out portal at: http://optout.aboutads.info/  . 
 
5. DO NOT TRACK   
Please note that we do not alter  our Site ’s data collection and use standard practices 
when we see a Do Not Track signal from your browser.  
 
6. YOUR RIGHTS   
If you are a European resident, you have the right to access personal information we 
hold about you and to ask that your personal i nformation be corrected, updated, or 
deleted. If you would like to exercise this right, please contact us through the contact 
information below.  
Additionally, if you are a European resident we note that we are processing your 
information in order to fulfil contracts we might have with you (for example if you make 
an order through the Site), or otherwise to pursue our legitimate business interests 
listed above. Additionally, please note that your information will be transferred outside 
of Europe, including t o Canada and the United States.  
 
7. DATA RETENTION   
When you place an order through the Site, we will maintain your Order Information for 
our records unless and until you ask us to delete this information.  
8.CHANGES   
We may update this privacy policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, 
changes to our practices or for other operational, legal or regulatory reasons.  
 
4 
 9. LINKS TO OTHER WEBSITES  
 Our website may contain links to third -party websites.  
 Important: Once you leave our site, we don ’t control these external sites.  
o We are not responsible for the privacy practices or protection of any 
information you provide on those sites.  
o Always review the privacy policies of other websites before sharing 
personal information.  
10. FRAUDULENT TRANSACTIONS  
 Solitario  Diamonds reserves the right to:  
o Recover the cost of goods, collection charges, and lawyers ’ fees from 
anyone who uses our site fraudulently.  
o Take legal action against individuals committing fraudulent activities or 
violating our Terms & Conditio ns. 
 All disputes are subject to Pune (India) jurisdiction.  
 
11.CONTACT US  
For more information about our privacy practices, if you have questions, or if you would 
like to make a complaint, please contact our Grievance Redressal Email  at 
paymentdesk@thesolitario.com  or by mail using the details provided below:  
 
SOLITARIO LAB GROWN PVT. LTD.  
Postal Address: #401, Vascon Eco Tower, Baner -Pashan Link Road, Baner, Pune, 
Maharashtra - 411045.

shipping_policy.content:
SHIPPING POLICY (SOLITARIO)  
 
Shipping Policy  
Free Shipping (India):  
We offer FREE shipping on all orders within India . 
● In-stock items:  48–72 hours  
● Make -to-order items:  Up to 25 business days  
All orders are fully insured, and we strongly encourage customers to inspect the 
package for any damage or tampering before accepting or signing for delivery.  
Shipments within India are fulfilled through third -party courier and logistics service 
providers as may be appointed by us at our discretion.  
International Shipping:  
We proudly ship to selected countries abroad.  
● Delivery Time:  Typically, 7 –21 business days, depending on the destination 
and customs clearance.  
● Shipping Charges:  Calculated at checkout ba sed on weight, value, and 
destination.  
● All international shipments are fully insured, and customers are responsible for 
any applicable customs duties or import taxes in the destination country.  
● Shipments are made via reliable international carriers to ensu re safe delivery.  
Packaging:  
Every jewellery item is delivered in durable, tamper -proof packaging. Your purchase, 
whether jewellery or solitaire, will arrive in an exclusive Solitario box, along with all 
relevant certificates.  
Free Gift Packaging:  
If your order is a gift, we provide complimentary gift packaging and include a 
personalized gift message of your choice. Your gift will arrive in distinctive Solitario gift 
packing, ensuring a memorable experience for the recipient.  
Policy Updates:  
We reserve the right to modify this shipping policy at any time. Please review it 
frequently. Any changes or clarifications take effect immediately upon posting on our 
website. For material updates, we will notify you here so you are aware of how we 
collect, use, and dis close information related to your order.

return,_exchange_&_buyback_policy.content:
1 
                    RETURN, EXCHANGE & BUYBACK POLICY (SOLITARIO)  
 
At Solitario , each piece of jewellery is crafted with precision and care. As jewellery is 
a high -value and made -to-order product, our return policy is designed to ensure 
transparency while protecting the interests of both our customers and the brand.  
 
EXCHANGE POLICY  
We offer an exchange facility on eligible jewellery items subject to the following 
conditions:  
 Requests for exchange must be raised within 7 days from the date of delivery.  
 The item must be unused, unworn, undamaged, and returned in its original 
condition, along with the original invoice, certificates, and packaging.  
 Products showing signs of wear, alteration, damage, or tampering will not be 
eligible for exchange.  
 Customised, en graved, or made -to-order jewellery may not be eligible for 
exchange unless otherwise stated.  
Any difference in price between the exchanged item and the new selection shall be 
payable by the customer or adjusted accordingly.  
 
BUYBACK POLICY  
We offer a buyba ck facility on jewellery purchased from us, subject to brand -specific 
terms and prevailing market conditions.  
 Buyback value is calculated based on the current metal value, gemstone 
valuation (if applicable), and applicable deductions as per company policy.  
2 
  Making charges, taxes, and other incidental costs are non -recoverable.  
 The buyback amount may be issued in the form of store credit or adjustment 
against a new purchase, as applicable.  
Detailed buyback terms may vary from product to product and are availa ble upon 
request.  
For any sort of Lifetime Exchange or buyback, we shall require the following:  
 Original Product  
 Original/Copy of Invoice  
  Product Certificate (If any)  
 Valid Government. ID Proof of the person making the Buyback/Exchange 
Request  
 Warranty Card  
 
REFUNDS  
As a general policy, we do not offer cash refunds.  
In exceptional cases, where a return is approved at our sole discretion, any eligible 
amount, if applicable, may be processed in a manner determined by the company, 
after necessary deductions . 
Return Process  
 All return, exchange, or buyback requests must be initiated by contacting our 
customer support team.  
 Items sent without prior approval will not be accepted.  
 The company reserves the right to inspect the product before approving any 
request . 
 
 
3 
 Important Notes  
 Shipping, handling, taxes, and certification charges are non -refundable.  
 The company reserves the right to modify or withdraw this policy at any time 
without prior notice.  
 All decisions taken by the company regarding returns, exchanges,  and 
buybacks shall be final and binding.  
To request a return of the product under the Exchange , Return  or Buyback Policy , 
contact us by  sending an email to  paymentdesk@thesolitario.com .
